title: Speaking — Getting advice
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on getting advice.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
Which kinds of decisions do you talk through with other people?
Do you prefer advice from someone with personal experience?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of advice that helped you make a choice.
part2.closing: and explain why the advice was effective.

questions: Why can good advice be difficult to act on?
What responsibilities do people have when giving advice online?
How has everyday life connected with getting advice changed for people of different ages?
